recovered_spec.primary_justification: Option A (skip) is PRIMARY: minimal, GT-free, zero-extra-cost; if the global model predicts no foreground there is no region to refine and the global output is preserved by fallback
recovered_spec.option_B: deterministic cheap uncertainty-based rescue — RETAINED ONLY AS A PRE-REGISTERED CONTROLLED ABLATION; any constant must be TRAIN-derived and frozen before Phase25

critical_finding: The 'rescue' concept is NOT one of the frozen ablation IDs R1/R2/R3. R1=router without deep global features; R2=router without task_id; R3=router with scalar-only features. The empty-prediction rescue (Option B) is a REFERENCE_PROPOSAL pre-registered ablation option with NO ablation ID and is NOT part of the frozen Phase24 ablation matrix. Label-based inference that 'R' means 'Rescue' would have been WRONG.
